child_gate: FD197, one byte G after parent records exact child PID/birth/PPID/PGID/SID and atomic STARTED; EOF/no GO exits without observer or query. Child taskset/prlimit/gate exec retain PID; observer Popen uses new session.

external_watchdog: Root sudo executes taskset CPU7 then GNU timeout --foreground TERM60/KILL+6 around prlimit and direct parent. Timeout may kill parent without closing observer/query; external caller must retain UNKNOWN and review actual sudo/timeout/parent lineage and direct terminal joins. Never use sudo exit as observer join.
parent_custody: Direct parent records gate child PID/birth/PPID/PGID/SID, writes exclusive intent/start records, polls waitid WNOWAIT and directly wait4-joins. On stop it may signal only same PID+birth+PPID+PGID+SID still unreaped; no group signal. TERM then KILL after 4 seconds, bounded wait 5.5 seconds from signal. KILL never proves query groups closed; parent errors, missing identity/join/summary, timeout and descendant escape remain UNKNOWN. On a positive observer result, observer self PID/start/PPID/parent birth/PGID/SID and all three query join records must match the gated direct child and recorded parent. V2 repeats the sealed validation after STARTED publication and immediately before G; any mismatch, expiration or stop closes the gate without G and retains UNKNOWN; pre-GO clocks are recorded in the terminal result.

release_rules: Root release must be root-owned regular nonsymlink single-link, no group/other bits and <=64KiB. Parent captures release, exact source and controller receipts with O_NOFOLLOW and stable fd/path identity, verifies hashes and original included-only/time requirements; immediately before gate GO it recaptures and requires same release JSON, raw bytes, sha256, device/inode and metadata and same bound source/control identities, then rechecks weekly freshness/expiry and UTC/BOOT/MONO ceilings. Failure closes gate with no G; direct bounded child join is attempted and uncertain outcomes remain UNKNOWN. External live service/controller authority, actual loaded-code/ancestry integrity, operation uniqueness and resource admission remain independent root obligations. V3 explicitly requires every listed schema key and exact actual_tighter_caps; it uses the actual armed tighter BOOT/MONO deadlines instead of the looser V2 constants, rejects both retained attempted nonces, and keeps the same UTC 1793774133 ceiling. A schema-only preseal pass grants no live control, authority or operation release.

A stable owner-controlled source/output ancestry and execution of exactly the hashed source bytes must be externally enforced; self-reading __file__ alone does not prove loaded code identity.
Caller must positively join and capture sudo/timeout identities and terminal results; sudo exit alone does not prove root observer/query retirement.
Watchdog command behavior, all actual read-only output/mount/resource identities and source controls require independent operation/execution review before first use.
Cgroup confinement and full descendant no-escape proof are not supplied; a missing/failed/forced observer join or any observer query error stays UNKNOWN and retains ownership.

A pending stop or root-owned control mutation concurrent with the final check must still be contained by the independent controller and stable-ancestry release; the check does not itself prove live account or daemon state.

Preseal regression is not an execution grant. Read and bind the current actual controller caps, live boot, service/usage, strict schema and source identity; enforce no new service/account rejection and nonce freshness independently.
New v3 output/release namespaces and inherited observer namespace must be absent immediately before release; preserve the old root-owned release and consumed v2 nonce.
